r78 director addendum, 2026-10-18. Supersedes P19's fixed90/100 HTTP deadlines and all-errors400 mapping.

Automatic startup inference: after Qwen3ASRModel.LLM loads and before uvicorn.run, main creates a private streaming state, feeds exactly2seconds of float32 zeros at16kHz, finishes streaming, then deletes the state/result. It is never inserted into session_cache; no transcript/PCM is logged or published. Duration and synthetic-startup/input_seconds/sample_rate/output_discarded/movie_credit=false metadata are logged and exposed by health. Exceptions abort startup. Existing supervisor600s load deadline bounds this startup stage; no model warmup is run by the implementation worker. This is startup inference, not translation/voice-quality evidence or movie credit.

Request contract: root config xt_asr_request_timeout_seconds defaults90 and validates30..90. XTServices passes --request-timeout-seconds and XTRANSLATE_ASR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from the same value. Server validates the range and waits that value. Qwen3ASRService validates the environment and derives read deadline=server+15 (default105), connect5; commit_stream shares recognize_stream. Existing barrier120s, hard900s and demo limits remain unchanged. No retries.

Errors preserve native success response fields but use structured HTTP504 on inference-wait TimeoutError,500 for other unexpected/inference exceptions,400 for recognized invalid-audio request errors,409 SessionPoisoned for an ID whose prior inference timed out. Timeout detail includes phase=inference,class,elapsed,session,stage and nonempty message; traceback logging remains. The poison set uses an independent lock and is separate from mutable per-session contexts so a late executor completion cannot clear it. Both request entry and the executor after acquiring gpu_lock check it. Cancellation cannot stop an already running worker; no request is retried and the existing fatal-session cleanup owns shutdown. The client HTTPError preserves the structured body; HTTP504/500/409 do not become transport retries.

Changed only existing owned Qwen server/backend services/XTServices argument-env wiring; model/controller/queue behavior unchanged. P19b-asr-startup-warmup.patch and r78b baselines saved. No tests/imports/apps/builds/models/warmup/GPU probes run by worker. The old15s timeout remains a strong inference from T193425Z rather than a proven original exception class.
